post.summary: Store an upload and record the resource
post.description: The gateway's `POST /resources`, forwarded untouched, with the principal the gateway verified. The Archivist stores the bytes at `storageUri`, outside git, and records the resource — as a clone of the token's source when the upload carries `cloneToken` — attributed to `Semiont-Principal`. It answers once the resource is recorded. An upload whose `Idempotency-Key` the Archivist holds for the same principal makes nothing new: with the same fields and bytes it is answered with the resource that key made, and with others it is refused 422. One that arrives while the first is still being recorded waits for it. The Archivist holds a key as long as the resource it made.

parameters.name: Semiont-Principal
parameters.description: The DID of the caller the gateway verified. The record attributes the resource to it. Believed because only a service account can call this route.

parameters.name: Semiont-Roles
parameters.description: That caller's roles, comma-separated; absent when it has none. A worker's `semiont-worker` is what obliges its upload to cite a job.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: The uploader's name for this upload, as the gateway received it: the same on every attempt at one upload.

200.description: The resource is recorded: by this upload, or by the first with its key.

400.description: `Semiont-Principal` or `Idempotency-Key` is missing; the body is not multipart/form-data, or not a ResourceUpload; the base media type is not supported; or `entityTypes` or `generator` is not what it must be. The message names what is wrong.

422.description: The `Idempotency-Key` names a resource its principal recorded from other fields or other bytes. Nothing is stored or recorded.

500.description: The bytes could not be stored, or the record refused the resource; the message says why.
